appDescription: A travel route planner for building, editing, and saving multi-stop driving itineraries in Korea.

function.name: CREATE_TRAVEL_ROUTE
function.description: Select an available multi-stop travel route for a requested Korean region.

region.description: The Korean city or travel region for the route.

function.name: EDIT_TRAVEL_ROUTE
function.description: Edit the active travel route by reversing the order, swapping two stops, or removing one stop.

first.description: The 1-based stop number used for swap or remove.

second.description: The second 1-based stop number for swapping.

function.name: SAVE_TRAVEL_ROUTE
function.description: Save the active travel route to the user's local route collection.

title.description: Optional name for the saved travel route.
